_comment: Phase HM-X1.3 -- byte-identical to v2 in every field except supportedRunsPerWeek, which is widened from [5] to [6]. This new additive version was required, not merely preferred: PlanCatalog.Core's CatalogGraphValidator (TC_LAYOUT_RUNS_PER_WEEK_NOT_SUPPORTED) hard-fails domain/graph validation for any combination whose bound RUN_LAYOUT's runsPerWeek is absent from its master's own supportedRunsPerWeek array -- confirmed by direct probe against the real validator, not assumed. v2 itself is left completely untouched (still [5], still the master half-marathon-5d-intermediate.v1.json resolves) so the existing public 5D combination has zero delta. This version reuses v2's own workoutProgression pointer (HALF_MARATHON_WORKOUT_PROGRESSION v2) unmodified -- lane binding is layout-driven, not frequency-driven (HM-X1.2 SS7), so no new progression content exists or is needed for 6D. CoreCycle (10/14/16) and the 2-week Taper phase are unchanged.
